name: Greenwarden's Grove
summary: Greenwarden's Grove is a serene night elven settlement nestled in the eastern Wetlands. Established around a mysterious guardian spirit, the camp provides Alliance travelers with rest, shelter, and a rare outpost of Cenarion harmony in a sodden, untamed land.

sections.title: Wardens of the Wetlands
sections.body: Night elves originally traveled to the marsh after hearing dwarven legends of a strange plant-like protector wandering the bogs. Upon discovering Rethiel the Greenwarden, the druids chose to stay, founding this quiet sanctuary to aid and watch over the enigmatic guardian. Led by the druid Ferilon Leafborn, the outpost boasts a moonwell, a traditional night elven tower, and an inn offering respite to wayfarers trekking between Dun Algaz and Arathi.

faq.q: Why are night elves living all the way out in the Wetlands?
aliases: why are there night elves here
faq.answer: Night elven druids journeyed to the Eastern Kingdoms after hearing dwarven legends about a mystical plant-creature safeguarding the marshes. After locating Rethiel the Greenwarden, they built this enclave to study, assist, and safeguard him.
The grove takes its name from Rethiel the Greenwarden, a sentient plant-like guardian native to the region who works tirelessly to cleanse and preserve the wetlands against encroaching corruption.
The enclave is overseen by Ferilon Leafborn, the head druid of the grove who directs the druids' local preservation efforts.

faq.q: What services can travelers find at Greenwarden's Grove?
faq.answer: Despite its remote location, the grove offers an inn, a hippogryph flight master connecting the camp to Alliance flight routes, and a tranquil moonwell.

angles.text: For druids exploring the Eastern Kingdoms, the grove and its moonwell offer a welcoming bastion of Cenarion balance amidst an otherwise damp and hostile wilderness.
This enclave serves as a familiar sanctuary far from Kalimdor, demonstrating your kin's dedication to nursing nature back to health wherever harmony is threatened.
